name: What factors determine the cost of a low threshold shower installation?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of a low threshold shower installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Costs vary widely based on materials, bathroom layout, and required plumbing modifications. A basic replacement using a prefabricated low threshold base and surround will be more affordable than a custom-tiled shower with specialty marble, glass enclosures, and built-in benches. Additional factors that impact cost include relocating the drain, repairing damaged subflooring, and adding accessibility features like blocking for grab bars. Working with a general contractor who manages both framing and finish trades ensures you receive an accurate estimate covering all project components.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost depends on material choices like tile versus prefab pans, subfloor condition, plumbing adjustments, and additions such as built-in seating or grab bars.
